subject: How to rhwrite data stored into multiple csv files.

messages.author: 0c2bffd1ce4a1edd
messages.subject: How to rhwrite data stored into multiple csv files.
parts:
Hi

I have a large dataset with records spanned into several .csv files in a HD.
I need to upload the dataset into HDFS has an R object to run a MapRed Rhipe job on it.

I am used to upload R objects by first loading them into a R object in memory, and then use rhwrite to write the R object into HDFS. 

With this dataset, I cannot load all files into R at once, because they do not fit into the memory.
Any suggestions please?

Thanks,
Rui
